overview: Roadie Roster is a hiring and orientation management app for a store's event roadies, tracking each roadie from hire through paperwork, orientation, training and certification.
features: One automatic progress tag per roadie: Hired, Paperwork Done, Oriented, In Training or Certified
Roster tabs for each stage with live counts, plus a Show former toggle
Stage shown on roster tiles, roadie cards, orientation rows, crew rows and group chips
Stage labels in English and Spanish
